title: idtrackerai-CYSM: Choose Your Segmentation Model
description:
A fork of idtracker.ai that accepts animal outlines from an external instance-segmentation model in place of its own intensity thresholding: a fine-tuned Detectron2 Mask R-CNN, or Meta's SAM 3 prompted with a word for the animal. SAM 3 can also draft LabelMe annotations for correction, as a way of preparing a Detectron2 dataset. Identity tracking is unchanged: crossing detection, fragmentation, identification and gap closing run exactly as in upstream idtracker.ai.

Unofficial; not affiliated with or endorsed by the de Polavieja Lab. The tracking method is theirs: please also cite Torrents, Costa & de Polavieja (2026), eLife 14, RP107602, https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.107602.
